info.title: US State Department travel advisories
info.description: Official U.S. Department of State travel advisory level (1-4) and summary for a country.

get.summary: Get the U.S. State Department travel advisory level and safety summary for a country.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Two-letter FIPS 10-4 country code used by the State Department (NOT ISO). Examples: FR=France, JA=Japan, GM=Germany, UK=United Kingdom, SP=Spain, IT=Italy, MX=Mexico, CH=China, IN=India, BR=Brazil, AS=Australia, EI=Ireland.

200.description: Advisory entries (empty array if code not found).
